summary.text: Angel Coon is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 102, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says Coon served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2011 to 2015 and works as an artist.

paragraphs.text: Coon earned a high school diploma from Holton High School, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Coon described being a U.S. Army veteran, small business owner, artist, community advocate and single mother.
Coon advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

In the survey, Coon named three campaign priorities: protecting individual rights and freedoms, building healthy communities, and restoring integrity and trust in government, and said the campaign is not accepting corporate PAC money.
Coon also said healthcare reform, mental health, preventive care and public education are areas of public policy of particular interest.
